## Course Information

- **Course Title:** Thermal Power Plant Simulator
- **Term:** Fall 2026
- **Schedule:** 4 periods per week, September to December
- **Credits:** [Insert credits]
- **Prerequisites:** Thermodynamics, Fluid Mechanics

## Learning Objectives

Students will be able to:
1. Simulate steady-state and transient operation of thermal power plants.
2. Analyze the performance of boilers, turbines, condensers, and feedwater systems.
3. Optimize plant efficiency and evaluate environmental performance.
4. Diagnose and troubleshoot common operational issues.

## Assessment

| Component              | Weight |
|------------------------|--------|
| Laboratory Simulations | 40%    |
| Assignments            | 25%    |
| Midterm Examination    | 15%    |
| Final Project          | 20%    |

## Policies

- All simulation reports must be submitted through the course platform.
- Late submissions will be penalized by 10% per day.
- Academic integrity is strictly enforced.
